info.name: Pioneer XDJ-R1 (NauticMixxx RX3)
info.author: Helton Lidio; NauticMixxx XDJ-R1 adaptation
info.description: Pioneer XDJ-R1 in MIDI mode, 2 decks on MIDI channels 1 and 2: 14-bit tempo, TEMPO RANGE, SOUND COLOR FX and COLOR, Beat FX, AUTO BEAT LOOP, hot cues with a KEY layer, VINYL mode, SYNC/MASTER and level meters, and the NauticMixxx RX3 browser.

control.description: MASTER: make this deck the sync leader
SHIFT + MASTER in BROWSE: MATCH filter (master deck key, tempo within 16%)
SHIFT + MASTER TEMPO: quantize on/off (both decks; lamp keeps showing keylock)
Jog top: scratch in VINYL mode, else pitch bend
AUTO BEAT LOOP press: loop on/off
SHIFT + AUTO BEAT LOOP turn: beat jump
SHIFT + MODE: HOT CUE / KEY layer
SHIFT + HOT CUE A (sampler mode): delete
SHIFT + HOT CUE B (sampler mode): delete
SHIFT + HOT CUE C (sampler mode): delete
SHIFT + TAP: Beat FX on the mids and highs only (lows stay dry)
SELECT turn: browse; in PERFORMANCE zoom the waveforms
SHIFT + SELECT turn: browse; in PERFORMANCE zoom the waveforms
SELECT press: load into deck 1 on the track list, else open/enter
SHIFT + SELECT press: always open/enter (never loads)
MASTER: make this deck the sync leader
SHIFT + MASTER in BROWSE: MATCH filter (master deck key, tempo within 16%)
SHIFT + MASTER TEMPO: quantize on/off (both decks; lamp keeps showing keylock)
Jog top: scratch in VINYL mode, else pitch bend
AUTO BEAT LOOP press: loop on/off
SHIFT + AUTO BEAT LOOP turn: beat jump
SHIFT + MODE: HOT CUE / KEY layer
SHIFT + HOT CUE A (sampler mode): delete
SHIFT + HOT CUE B (sampler mode): delete
SHIFT + HOT CUE C (sampler mode): delete
SHIFT + TAP: Beat FX on the mids and highs only (lows stay dry)
SELECT turn: browse; in PERFORMANCE zoom the waveforms
SHIFT + SELECT turn: browse; in PERFORMANCE zoom the waveforms
SELECT press: load into deck 2 on the track list, else open/enter
SHIFT + SELECT press: always open/enter (never loads)
